$ /bin/bash -c python3 - <<'PY'
import json
s=json.load(open('openapi.json'))
for n in ['EvalSuiteCreateRequest','EvalRunCreateRequest']:
print(n,json.dumps(s['components']['schemas'][n]))
for n,v in s['components']['schemas'].items():
if any(t in n.lower() for t in ['step','assertion']):print(n,json.dumps(v))
